original_target.title: Orthogonal separation of independent Gaussian polynomial statistics

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original independent arbitrary-degree nonconstant real polynomials of a standard Gaussian must separate into orthogonal disjoint coordinate blocks, without convexity or chaos restriction. Harge Theorem1.2 imposes convexity of both functions and analyticity/minimum-at-origin of one; Hong–Hu impose symmetric quasi-convex polynomials. Gaussian product inequalities and complex moment counterexamples do not establish the original independent-real-pair statement. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
